method: Exhaustive scan of all screen text blocks (excluding up_next blocks which are passing mentions by design) and ~1/3 sample of interaction prompts/options/feedback for references to blocked_future_concepts. Checked all 15 unique tiles across screens.json and all 48 interactions in interactions.json.

advisory_issues.description: Step s03 uses pd.DataFrame() to illustrate fact f4 (constructing a DataFrame from a dict of lists). The keyword pd.DataFrame() also appears in the later concept pandas.creating_dataframes. However, fact f4 of pandas.dataframe_series_model explicitly covers this construction, so this is teaching the current concept's own fact, not leaking a future concept. No change needed.

All recap steps contain up_next blocks that preview the next tile's concepts by name (e.g., sort_values, groupby, pivot_table, to_csv). These are passing mentions that do not require the learner to understand the future concept. No change needed.
